verdict.rationale: Reader documents its own anti-bot capability: the SaaS proxy mode (`x-proxy: auto`) rotates residential and datacenter IPs and handles common anti-bot challenges automatically. It also offers a headless Chrome engine via `x-engine: browser`. However, no stealth or undetected browser fingerprinting mode is documented, and the claim covers only 'common' challenges, not sophisticated detection systems. missing for 10: an explicit undetected/stealth browser mode, evidence of bypassing sophisticated bot detection (e.g., advanced fingerprinting/CAPTCHA systems), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use an undetected browser mode to bypass sophisticated bot detection systems

citations.quote: Reader's hosted proxy pool rotates residential / datacenter IPs and handles common anti-bot challenges automatically.
`x-engine` — enforces a fetching engine: `browser` (headless Chrome), `curl` (lightweight, no JS), or `auto`
